```sql
WITH kohli_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        MAX(d.batting_team) FILTER (WHERE d.batter = 'V Kohli') AS kohli_team,
        SUM(d.batter_runs) FILTER (WHERE d.batter = 'V Kohli') AS runs_scored
    FROM deliveries d
    GROUP BY d.match_id
)
SELECT AVG(runs_scored)::numeric(10,2) AS avg_score
FROM kohli_scores ks
JOIN matches m ON ks.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE ks.kohli_team IS NOT NULL
  AND m.winner IS NOT NULL
  AND ks.kohli_team <> m.winner;
```
